_comment: Ground truth for the partial-with-trap benchmark. The firewall is graded two-sided, like the PII auditor: RECALL (catch every planted trap) + PRECISION (do not flag a single real citation as a trap).

proposition_trap._comment: T3: a REAL citation carrying a FALSE proposition. Undetectable offline. The firewall must NOT pass it silently — it must mark it UNVERIFIED and surface the asserted proposition so the advocate catches the lie when he reads the case.
